mapper.select: SELECT PAR.COUNTER_ID counterId, PAR.COUNTER_TYPE counterType, PAR.COUNTER_NAME counterName, PAR.LINK_ID customerId, PAR.LINK_ID finprodId, PAR.MANAGER_ID managerId, PAR.HEAD_BANK headBank, PAR.CONTACT contact, PAR.CONTACT_WAY contactWay, PAR.REMARK remark, TYPE.TYPE_6 type1, TYPE.TYPE_7 type2, PLAN.REP_CAPI_INVEST repCapiInvest, PLAN.REP_CAP_USE_WAY repCapUseWay, PLAN.REP_CAP_USE_INDU repCapUseIndu, PLAN.REP_PLAN_PROP repPlanProp, (CASE WHEN PLAN.REP_YIELD_FLAG=#{SVR_YES_OR_NO_YES} THEN #{YES_OR_NO_YES} WHEN #{SVR_YES_OR_NO_NO} THEN #{YES_OR_NO_NO} ELSE PLAN.REP_YIELD_FLAG END) repYieldFlag, PLAN.REP_MAX_RATE repMaxRate, PLAN.REP_MIN_RATE repMinRate, PLAN.REP_BUY_STRUCT repBuySruct, PLAN.REP_MANAGE_TYPE repManageType, (CASE WHEN PLAN.REP_IS_CTRL_BOTTOM=#{SVR_YES_OR_NO_YES} THEN #{YES_OR_NO_YES} WHEN #{SVR_YES_OR_NO_NO} THEN #{YES_OR_NO_NO} ELSE PLAN.REP_IS_CTRL_BOTTOM END) repIsCtrlBttom, PLAN.REP_AMT repAmt, PLAN.REP_REMARK repRemarks, PLAN.REP_PARTY_CODE repPartyCode, PLAN.REP_REGIST_CODE repRegistCode, PLAN.REP_SET_DATE repSetDate, PLAN.REP_END_DATE repEndDate, PLAN.REP_TRADE_FEE_RATE * 100 repTradeFeeRate, PLAN.REP_AGENCY_FEE_RATE *100 repAgencyFeeRate, PLAN.REP_OTHER_FEE_RATE *100 repOtherFeeRate, FIN.TRUSTEE_ID trusteeId, PA.BANK_TRUST_CODE bankTrustCode, PAR.P_TYPE_ONE pTypeOne, PAR.P_TYPE_TWO pTypeTwo FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY PAR LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FIN ON PAR.LINK_ID = FIN.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE TYPE ON PAR.LINK_ID = TYPE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_MNG_PLAN PLAN ON PAR.LINK_ID = PLAN.REP_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT PA ON PA.FINPROD_ID = FIN.FINPROD_ID WHERE PAR.COUNTER_ID = #{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
